# AbeBooks

> > AbeBooks is a global online marketplace connecting buyers with independent booksellers offering rare books, antiquarian books, first editions, signed copies, art books, and collectibles.

Founded as a network of independent booksellers, AbeBooks features millions of new, used, rare, and out-of-print books from thousands of sellers worldwide. The platform specializes in connecting collectors and readers with hard-to-find titles, from antiquarian treasures to contemporary collectibles, with a strong presence of ILAB (International League of Antiquarian Booksellers) and ABAC member dealers.

## Key Topics

- ILAB (International League of Antiquarian Booksellers)
- Antiquarian books and rare books
- Book collecting and collectibles
- Independent booksellers and dealers
- First editions and signed copies
- Portuguese colonial history and literature
- German-language antiquarian books
- French literature and legal texts
- 19th-century publications
- Art books and exhibition catalogs
- ABAC (Antiquarian Booksellers' Association of Canada)
- Used and out-of-print books
- Book condition grading (hardcover, softcover)
- European booksellers (Portugal, France, Germany)
- Curated book collections

## Marketplace Overview

- [AbeBooks | Shop for Books, Art & Collectibles](https://www.abebooks.com/): Homepage: marketplace for rare books and collectibles from global sellers
- [Shop Art, Books & Collectibles - Curated Collections | AbeBooks](https://www.abebooks.com/collections/): Curated collections of rare books, art, and collectibles from sellers

## Portuguese History & Literature

- [ÁLBUM DE PALEOGRAFIA E DIPLOMÁTICA PORTUGUESAS](https://www.abebooks.com/%C3%81LBUM-PALEOGRAFIA-DIPLOM%C3%81TICA-PORTUGUESAS-3.%C2%AA-EDI%C3%87%C3%83O/22449892480/bd): Book listing: Portuguese paleography album with facsimiles (1976 ed.)
- [ÁLVARO PIRES DE ÉVORA. UM PINTOR PORTUGUÊS NA ITÁLIA DO QUATTROCENTO](https://www.abebooks.com/%C3%81LVARO-PIRES-%C3%89VORA-PINTOR-PORTUGU%C3%8AS-IT%C3%81LIA/30107606657/bd): Book listing: Exhibition catalog of Portuguese Quattrocento painter (1994)
- [ÉVORA ENCANTADORA](https://www.abebooks.com/%C3%89VORA-ENCANTADORA-DAVID-Celestino/30609749597/bd): Book listing: Celestino David's Évora history (1923, limited 2004 reprint)
- [A ÍNDIA PORTUGUESA ANTIGA E MODERNA](https://www.abebooks.com/%C3%8DNDIA-PORTUGUESA-ANTIGA-MODERNA-CUNHA-Ant%C3%B3nio/22729795024/bd): Book listing: Portuguese India history with 1911 Durbar coronation (1935)
- [ÍNDIA PORTUGUESA: PENHORES DO SEU RESGATE](https://www.abebooks.com/%C3%8DNDIA-PORTUGUESA-PENHORES-SEU-RESGATE-MARQUES/30115729699/bd): Book listing: Illustrated Portuguese India colonial history (1962 ed.)
